public.text: The section recommends a multistakeholder funding model and possible contribution or fee structures. Charging for access to shared infrastructure could create barriers for small providers, community organisations, or under-resourced regions.
public.suggestedRevision: Add equity safeguards, including exemptions or subsidies for essential and low-resource users, transparent cost-allocation principles, prohibition of discriminatory access, and assessment of whether fees could reduce health-service availability.
